name: Dynamic Octree Growth Algorithm
definition: An algorithm to build a Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) by dynamically increasing its depth and spatial extent as new voxels are processed, rather than pre-calculating the size. It handles both positive and negative coordinates by centering the root at the boundary between -1 and 0.
summary: The Dynamic Octree Growth Algorithm builds Sparse Voxel Octrees by dynamically expanding depth and spatial extent to handle any coordinates without pre-calculating bounding boxes.
